2017 GMC Sierra 1500 SLE Crimson Red Tintcoat 4WD EcoTec3 5.3L V8
Recent Arrival!

SLE Value Package adds useful everyday features, and this truck is set up with 4WD, Auto 4WD, all-wheel drive capability, and a 2-speed transfer case for changing road and weather conditions.
The tow package includes a trailer brake controller, tow/haul mode, trailer sway control, and a locking rear differential to make towing feel more controlled.
Heated front seats, remote vehicle start, power adjustable pedals, and a universal home remote add comfort and convenience from the moment you get in.
A backup camera and rear park assist help when backing into tight spaces or lining up a trailer.
Bluetooth hands-free calling, voice-activated audio, USB input, and a built-in WiFi hotspot help you stay connected on the go.
OnStar with Directions & Connections and SiriusXM capability add extra convenience for navigation help, communication, and entertainment.
The 6-passenger cabin uses front and rear bench seating, with a 40/20/40 front split bench and 60/40 split-folding rear seat for flexible people-and-cargo use.
The 5.3L V8 delivers strong truck power, paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission and hill-start assist control.
A power sliding rear window makes it easier to bring in fresh air or reach the bed area from the cab.
17-inch alloy wheels give it a clean truck look, and the bright machined aluminum finish adds a little extra style.
Heated power mirrors, deep-tinted glass, automatic HID projector headlights, and daytime running lights help with visibility in different conditions.
The EZ-Lift locking tailgate, cargo bed tie-down hooks, cargo box lighting, and rear bumper step make bed access and loading more convenient.
Rubber and vinyl floor mats are easy to clean after work or weekend use.
Cruise control, a leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio and cruise controls, power windows, and power door locks keep daily driving simple.
Safety features include 6 airbags, ABS, traction control, stability control, rollover mitigation, tire pressure monitoring, LATCH child-seat anchors, and Teen Driver mode.
A full-size spare tire, front recovery hooks, and a heavy-duty battery support truck duty when you need it.
Remainder of factory warranty coverage may still be available, with powertrain and roadside assistance coverage listed in the factory warranty data.

- Power Sunroof
- 10.25 Navigation System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Leather-Wrapped Steering Wheel and Shift Knob
- Heated Front Bucket Seats
- Dual Automatic Temperature Control

The heart of this Tucson is its efficient 2.5L I4 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission, delivering 23 city and 29 highway miles per gallon. All-wheel drive enhances traction and stability, making this vehicle responsive in various driving conditions while maintaining excellent fuel economy for its class.

Inside, the Tucson SEL surrounds you with thoughtful comfort features. Heated front seats keep you warm during colder months, while the dual automatic temperature control ensures your passengers stay comfortable. The leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob add a premium feel to your daily commute, and the power sunroof provides natural light and an open-air experience when you want it.

Technology seamlessly integrates into your life here. The 10.25-inch touchscreen navigation system and digital instrument cluster keep you informed and connected. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility means your smartphone integrates naturally with the vehicle, and the six-speaker audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio keeps entertainment flowing on every journey.

Safety and convenience work together in this Tucson. description:
The 2025 Toyota Corolla LE offers a practical and reliable sedan built to meet your daily driving needs with confidence and efficiency.

- Blind Spot Monitor
- Rear Cross-Traffic Alert (RCTA)
- Color-Keyed Heated Power Outside Mirrors
- Qi-Compatible Wireless Charger
- Smart Key System with Push Button Start
- 16" Alloy Wheels
- 8" Toyota Audio Multimedia with Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
- Automatic Temperature Control
- Fully Automatic Headlights with Delay-off Feature
- Emergency Communication System: Safety Connect
- Rear Window Defroster
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- All Weather Floor Liner Package: Tub Style
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- 6 Speakers with SiriusXM

This Corolla delivers solid fuel economy with 32 mpg in the city and 41 mpg on the highway, making it an economical choice for your commute and weekend drives. The 2.0L four-cylinder engine paired with a CVT transmission provides smooth acceleration while maintaining efficiency. Whether navigating city streets or cruising the highway, this sedan handles responsively and predictably.

The LE Premium Package equips you with modern convenience features that enhance your driving experience. Heated power mirrors with color-keyed styling keep you comfortable during colder months, while the wireless charger keeps your devices powered throughout the day. The blind spot monitor and rear cross-traffic alert provide additional visibility and peace of mind when changing lanes or backing out of parking spaces.

Inside, you'll find thoughtful design elements that make every journey more comfortable. The 8-inch touchscreen integrates Apple CarPlay and Android Auto for seamless smartphone connectivity, while steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road. Automatic temperature control maintains your preferred cabin environment, and the split-folding rear seat offers flexibility for passengers or cargo.

The black exterior presents a clean, professional appearance that maintains its appeal over time. Alloy wheels with locks add a touch of refinement, while door edge guards and mudguards provide practical protection. All-weather floor liners protect your interior from dirt and moisture, preserving the cabin's condition year-round.

Safety remains paramount in this Corolla's design. Dual front airbags, side-impact airbags, and knee airbags surround occupants with protection. Electronic stability control and traction control work together to maintain vehicle grip in challenging conditions, while ABS brakes with brake assist provide confident stopping power. The emergency communication system offers added security during unexpected situations.

This 2025 Toyota Corolla LE represents dependable transportation with the features and protection you deserve. Visit our showroom today to experience the comfort, efficiency, and reliability this sedan provides.

The 2018 Volkswagen Beetle S carries forward one of the most recognizable silhouettes in automotive history, and this generation backs that iconic shape with genuinely modern engineering underneath. Finished in classic Pure White, this Beetle pairs timeless curb appeal with the kind of everyday drivability that keeps VW's most famous nameplate relevant year after year.

Few cars turn heads and draw smiles quite like the Beetle does, and that charm hasn't faded with time. Behind the retro styling sits a genuinely capable small hatchback, one that trades nostalgia-only appeal for real substance on the road. WHY SHOPPERS BUY THIS MODEL The Beetle has always occupied a category of one, a car people choose with their heart as much as their head. Buyers gravitate toward it not for outright practicality, but because nothing else on the road delivers the same instantly recognizable personality while still functioning as a genuinely competent daily driver.

For 2018, Volkswagen gave the Beetle real teeth to back up its looks, and reviewers took notice of how composed and mature the car felt for something built around such a whimsical shape. It's a combination that continues to win over shoppers who want their commuter car to feel like an extension of their personality rather than an appliance. AUTOMOTIVE PRESS AND INDUSTRY RECOGNITION The redesigned-for-2018 Beetle earned consistent praise from the automotive press for its surprisingly composed ride quality and its willingness to deliver genuine everyday usability without sacrificing the model's signature character. Reviewers noted that the Beetle's underpinnings, shared with the Golf platform, gave it a level of refinement that belied its playful exterior, absorbing bumps with more grace than its retro styling might suggest. WARRANTY The odometer is hovering around the 51,621-mile mark.

Based on the original registration date of February 12, 2018, this Beetle is well beyond Volkswagen's transferable factory coverage window, so no factory warranty protection remains active on this vehicle. A documented 18-record service history reflects a level of consistent care that speaks well to how this Beetle has been maintained, and with generally favorable mileage for a car of this age, it should have plenty of dependable miles ahead. Extended service plans may be available to provide additional peace of mind moving forward. STANDARD FEATURES The S trim delivers the Beetle's core appeal in its purest form, headlined by a newly standard turbocharged engine that replaced the outgoing model's less powerful unit. Buyers who choose the S get the same iconic shape and genuinely capable driving dynamics as the rest of the lineup, without paying for the extra convenience and technology content found on the higher SE and Dune trims. INSTALLED OPTIONS Chrome Exhaust Tips (Set of Two) Adds a subtle, upscale finishing touch to the Beetle's rear fascia. MECHANICAL FEATURES Power comes from a turbocharged 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine producing 174 horsepower and 184 lb-ft of torque, a genuine step up in output over the smaller engine it replaced. Paired with a six-speed automatic transmission, it delivers brisk, confident acceleration around town and comfortable passing power on the highway.

Front-wheel drive keeps things simple and predictable, while the Beetle's Golf-derived platform gives it a surprisingly composed, well-controlled ride that soaks up rough pavement with more maturity than its playful shape might suggest. EXTERIOR FEATURES The Beetle's rounded roofline, arched fenders, and unmistakable proportions remain as instantly recognizable today as when the model first debuted. Pure White paint keeps the focus squarely on that iconic shape, while the chrome exhaust tips add a small but genuine touch of polish to the rear end. For a *2013 model*, 46,000 miles is remarkably low.

When shopping for an older luxury convertible, condition and mileage can make a tremendous difference. Many comparable A5 Cabriolets have accumulated substantially more use over the years, which makes a *46K-mile example* particularly appealing.

Introducing this 2007 Chevrolet Monte Carlo LS, a stylish and comfortable front-wheel-drive coupe finished in White with a Gray interior. This Monte Carlo combines classic Chevrolet coupe styling with practical everyday features, making it an appealing choice for anyone looking for a distinctive pre-owned vehicle.

Under the hood is a 3.5L V6 SFI engine with FlexFuel capability, producing 211 horsepower and 214 lb-ft of torque. The engine is paired with an electronic 4-speed automatic transmission with overdrive and front-wheel drive, providing a smooth and familiar driving experience. The Monte Carlo also features a touring suspension, power rack-and-pinion steering, four-wheel independent suspension, and P225/60R16 all-season tires mounted on 16-inch 5-spoke styled cast aluminum wheels.

Inside, the Gray cabin provides a comfortable layout with cloth seating, front bucket seats, air conditioning with filtration, a power driver s seat with manual lumbar adjustment, power windows with driver Express-Down, remote trunk release, electronic cruise control, and a tilt steering column. The rear seat features a split-folding design for added versatility. Additional conveniences include an analog instrument cluster with Driver Information Center, rear-window electric defogger, manual day/night rearview mirror, covered vanity mirrors, interior dome lighting, and a 6-speaker audio system with AM/FM stereo and CD player.

Safety and convenience features include the LATCH child-seat anchoring system, trunk emergency release handle, Tire Pressure Monitoring System, PASSlock theft-deterrent system, and maintenance-free battery with retained accessory power. An oil life monitoring system also helps keep track of routine maintenance needs.

This 2007 Chevrolet Monte Carlo LS offers a combination of V6 performance, coupe styling, comfortable seating, useful technology, and classic Chevrolet character.

description:
Introducing the 2027 Ford Expedition Max King Ranch, a full-size SUV designed for those who demand capability and comfort in one commanding package.

- Rear-Seat Entertainment
- Ford Connectivity Package with 7-year access
- B&O Unleashed Sound System with 22 speakers and SiriusXM 360L
- Google Maps Navigation system
- Panoramic Vista Roof
- Heated and ventilated premium Del Rio leather front captain's chairs
- Heated steering wheel
- Power moonroof
- Heated and cooled front seats
- Heated rear seats
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- 22-inch sinister bronze diamond cut machined face aluminum wheels
- Heavy-duty trailer tow with integrated trailer brake control
- Electronic stability control and four-wheel independent suspension
- Dual zone automatic climate control with rear air conditioning

The King Ranch trim delivers distinctive styling and premium appointments throughout. Black exterior paint is complemented by body-color bumpers, a front active air dam, and power door mirrors with heating capability. The 22-inch alloy wheels are finished in sinister bronze with diamond cut machined faces, giving this Expedition Max a presence that commands attention on any road.

Step inside to find an expertly appointed cabin featuring genuine wood dashboard and door panel inserts that reflect the King Ranch's heritage. The heated and ventilated premium Del Rio leather front captain's chairs provide support for long journeys, while the leather steering wheel with heating function and memory settings ensures your driving position is precisely tailored to your preferences. Dual zone automatic climate control keeps front passengers comfortable, while rear passengers enjoy their own air conditioning system.

Technology integration is seamless with Ford Digital Experience, Google Maps navigation, and wireless connectivity to Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The B&O Unleashed Sound System with 22 speakers delivers premium audio quality, enhanced by SiriusXM 360L satellite radio with a seven-year Ford Connectivity Package included. A panoramic vista roof floods the interior with natural light, while rear-seat entertainment keeps passengers engaged on extended trips.

Safety and capability are engineered throughout. The four-wheel independent suspension combined with electronic stability control and traction control provides confident handling in varied driving conditions. Heavy-duty trailer tow capability with integrated trailer brake control makes this Expedition Max ready for authentic work. Standard dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags work with the occupant sensing system to protect all passengers. An exterior parking camera rear assists with maneuvering this full-size SUV in tight spaces.

The EcoBoost 3.5L V6 twin-turbocharged engine delivers substantial power while maintaining fuel efficiency ratings of 15 city and 22 highway mpg. The 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD system ensure smooth acceleration and reliable traction in demanding conditions. With only 1 mile on the odometer, this Expedition Max is ready to begin its journey with you.

This vehicle represents the pinnacle of what a full-size SUV can offer: premium comfort, advanced technology, capable performance, and thoughtful design. We invite you to experience the 2027 Ford Expedition Max King Ranch in person and discover why it stands as the choice for families and individuals who refuse to compromise on quality or capability.

Safety and visibility reach every direction. Four-wheel independent suspension with electronic stability control and traction control work together to keep you grounded on any surface. Front fog lights and auto-dimming door mirrors reduce glare, while the comprehensive airbag system including dual front, front side, knee, and overhead protections surrounds you with security. The 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine paired with a continuously variable transmission delivers 22 city and 28 highway MPG, balancing efficiency with the all-wheel-drive capability that defines this model. description:
This 2023 Ford Escape ST-Line Select delivers a refined driving experience with a balance of capability and everyday practicality that modern drivers expect from a compact SUV.

- Panoramic Vista Roof with power open/close and power shade
- AWD for enhanced traction and control
- EcoBoost 2.0L turbocharged engine with 8-speed automatic transmission
- SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition and 13.2 touchscreen
- 360-Degree Camera with Split View
- Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Connected Built-In Navigation with live traffic and pinch-to-zoom
- B&O Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with 10 speakers and SiriusXM
- Intelligent Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop-and-Go
- Ford Co-Pilot360 Assist 2.0 with Evasive Steering Assist and Intersection Assist
- 10-Way Power Driver's Seat and 6-Way Power Passenger Seat with Memory Package
- Wireless Charging Pad and SecuriCode Keyless Entry Keypad
- Class II Trailer Tow Package
- 19 Machined-Face Ebony-Painted Aluminum Wheels with Black Roof-Rack Side Rails
- No accidents with regular oil changes

The powertrain combines a turbocharged 2.0L EcoBoost engine with an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, delivering an efficient blend of performance and fuel economy. You'll achieve an estimated 23 city MPG and 31 highway MPG, making this Escape a practical choice for both daily commutes and longer journeys.

Technology integration stands out as a major strength. SYNC 4 simplifies vehicle control with enhanced voice recognition, while the 13.2-inch capacitive touchscreen provides intuitive access to navigation, entertainment, and vehicle settings. Cloud connectivity and AppLink extend functionality, and both wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto ensure your smartphone integrates seamlessly with the vehicle's systems.

Safety features demonstrate Ford's commitment to driver confidence. Ford Co-Pilot360 Assist 2.0 combines intelligent adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go capability, evasive steering assist, intersection assist, and speed sign recognition. The 360-degree camera system with split view gives you comprehensive visibility, while rear parking sensors and reverse brake assist support maneuvering with precision.

Comfort and convenience features create an inviting interior. The panoramic vista roof with power open/close and integrated power shade brings light and openness to the cabin. Heated front seats, a heated steering wheel, and dual-zone automatic climate control adapt to seasonal needs and personal preference. The memory package for driver's seat and mirrors ensures consistent positioning for regular drivers.

This well-maintained Escape with no accident history and consistent service records represents a solid opportunity for buyers seeking a modern, feature-rich compact SUV ready for the road ahead.
